description: Share a website, app, agent, or skill by email: each address is mailed a link, whatever the service's access mode, and sharing does not change who else can reach it. The link comes from Valet and opens the service; the recipient needs no Valet account of their own, only the link, so anyone holding the email can open it and forwarding it forwards access. An app runs server code, so a person it is shared with can use everything the app does, including anything that changes data. An agent can be shared only on a server with agent outside access turned on. Sharing again with an address that already has access re-sends the same link rather than creating a second one. Requires connecting a Valet account.

access_ttl.description: How long access lasts once the link is first opened, after which the link stops working, such as 30m or 7d. Omit for access that never expires this way. Composes with expires_in: the unopened deadline governs until the first open replaces it.

emails.description: The email addresses to share it with. An address that already has access is sent the same link again.

expires_in.description: How long from now the link works if nobody has opened it yet, such as 24h or 7d. Omit for a link that never expires this way.

kind.description: Omit to share whatever the name holds; give it to have a name holding another kind refused.

message.description: A note included in the email, shown to the recipient as a quote beside the link.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the website, app, agent, or skill belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: share_service

kind.description: Kind of the thing shared: site, app, agent, or skill.

name.description: Name of the website, app, agent, or skill that was shared.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

results.description: One entry per address, in the order the call named them.

email.description: The email address this entry reports on.

email_error.description: Why the mail did not go out. Absent when it did. The share is recorded either way.

emailed.description: True when the mail went out. When false, read email_error.

share_id.description: Id of the share granted to this address.

state.description: created when the address got a new share, resent when it already had one and the link was mailed again.

title: Share a website, app, agent, or skill by email
